prompt:
Use case: style-transfer / background redesign.
Image1 is the EDIT TARGET: one continuous wide OneBeat seaside promenade panorama. Image2 is the APP'S ORIGINAL COMIC BRAND ART and is the primary drawing-style reference. Redesign image1 into a gender-neutral, mature American indie-comic / skate-culture illustration, matching the stronger ink character of image2. Keep it ONE single ultra-wide continuous scene, never a grid or divided panels. Intended master layout is 6480x1920, aspect27:8, so make the artwork as wide and crisp as possible.

Keep the recognizable original OneBeat characters and the continuous story of a seaside walkway that reaches an urban street corner. Lilroll has purple skin/hoodie, messy green hair and lime skate helmet; Scooter has a black helmet and acid-yellow jacket; Cloud Walker has exactly one large eye, blue skin, white fluffy head and small wings, and plays a small drum; the mint teapot walker wears an apron dress and boots. Preserve simple natural walking/drumming poses and clear limb anatomy. Character-specific purple clothing is fine; purple must NOT be the dominant background.

NEW ART DIRECTION:
Bold, confident near-black ink contours and visible purposeful crosshatching. Broad graphic light/shadow masses, limited screenprint inks and restrained grain like a high-quality independent comic book or skate magazine spread. More grounded and graphic, less cute confectionery. Avoid soft airbrushed gradients and glossy 3D. Use subtle halftone inside a few shadow areas only, with clean breathing space.

COLOR:
Main base is warm natural paper #FFF9EE, with charcoal ink #171B1F. Sea and small environmental accents use muted / ink-shaded versions of OneBeat teal #29B5AE. Small coral orange #FF7056 accents add warmth. Neutral warm concrete, paper cream and grey-green dominate. REMOVE the lavender/pink sky and pastel pink cloud shading. Sky should be quiet warm cream with a few strong economical ink cloud strokes and pale neutral stone-grey shadows. No purple or lilac color field, no pink horizon, no candy pastels.

ENVIRONMENT:
One long cream/concrete promenade, continuous from the far left to far right. On the left: a calm rocky seaside lookout, low concrete or steel guardrail and wind-shaped coarse grasses. Center: sparse robust shrubs, a simple park bench and the cloud drummer. On the far right: a modest urban street corner with a simple metal street lamp and a few blocky brick/storefront silhouettes; no readable signage. Replace flower beds and delicate decorative blossoms with grasses, architectural edges, broad leaves, stones and a few practical street details. Keep the place human and relaxed, not dystopian or aggressive.
Maintain one coherent horizon, side-on scale and continuous sea/path/rail rhythm across the full width. No repeated six-scene collages or changes in perspective at invisible page boundaries.

FOR APP SCREENSHOT USE:
The whole illustration will be used BEHIND six large white phone screens. Keep top ~30% mostly quiet off-white paper with sparse low-contrast cloud marks for later headlines. Distribute scenery and character groups across the full middle/lower width; don't pack everything in one center. Clear edges and uncluttered silhouettes. Printed texture should never dominate the scene or compete with the UI.

No phones, no UI, no device frames, no rectangular panels, no words, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark. Do not copy the huge lettering from image2. Opaque full-width background. ONE finished neutral American-comic panorama.
